draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Willow Works' setup
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Totally understandable — thanks for the honest update, and no rush on your end.

When you do get a window, the one step that makes the rest click is creating a first real project: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, so it's a short lift.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I can walk through that first project with you live so it's done before you go heads-down again.

Best,
Nadia
